data.long_meaning: The meaning of Jevon is recorded in name-lists as “Young warrior”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jevon expresses “Young warrior”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jevon total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
